text.en:
Section five hundred and one of Act Numbered Twenty-seven hundred and eleven, known as the
Administrative Code, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 501. Exemption of military or other employees of the United States from taxation.-The personal
property of persons employed in the military or other service of the United States in the Philippine Islands and
used by them incident to said service shall be exempt from taxation."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 13, 1931.
